subject: English Home Language

source.topic: This is where people live: Emergent Writing
source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'd' (sand tray, chalk, sawdust letter)

show.line: Let's write d. Go round like a ball, then a tall line up and down. d, d, door!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says d, as in door.
This letter says d. Say the sound!
Trace d with your finger. Round first, then a tall line up and down.
Look carefully. Which one is d? The tummy is on the left.

hints: d starts round, then a tall line.
Round first, then go up tall and back down.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write d for door.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Round, then a short line. Look, I wrote d!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is a. d needs a tall line.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Round, then a tall line. That is d!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter d, say its sound and trace it.
